# rubrik_aws_cloud_application (List Resource)

The `rubrik_aws_cloud_application` list resource lists the AWS Cloud Applications in RSC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "rubrik_aws_cloud_application" "all" {
  provider = rubrik
}

list "rubrik_aws_cloud_application" "by_name" {
  provider = rubrik

  config {
    name = "web-store"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter applications by name. Matches names containing the given value.
